items.original: IV therapy administers vitamins, minerals, antioxidants and amino acids directly into the bloodstream through intravenous infusion. It bypasses the digestive system and has been clinically shown to be more effective than oral supplements.

items.original: Our treatments are administered by experienced registered nurses using safe, effective procedures, after a Good Faith Exam with a licensed provider. Our spa consultants guide you through the process and build a personalized plan.

items.where: p · How long does IV therapy stay in my system?
items.original: Fluids and electrolytes 2–3 days; vitamins 2–3 weeks (water-soluble C and B used within a day); minerals 1–2 weeks; antioxidants like glutathione 1–3 days. Effects on energy, skin and immunity often last longer.
